name: Used Electric Vehicle Rebate
description: $2,000 instant rebate toward a used plug-in hybrid or fully-electric vehicle from a participating dealer; can combine with other rebates
fullDescription: WestLight Energy (formerly Peninsula Clean Energy) helps income-qualified San Mateo County and Los Banos residents afford electric vehicles with a $2,000 instant rebate toward used plug-in hybrids or fully-electric vehicles.
whatTheyOffer:
- $2,000 instant rebate at time of purchase
- Covers used plug-in hybrid and fully-electric vehicles at least 2 model years old
- Must buy from a WestLight Energy participating dealership (no private-party or online sales)
- No maximum vehicle price
- Can combine with PG&E Pre-Owned EV Rebate and Clean Cars for All
howToGetIt:
1. Must live in San Mateo County or Los Banos and not have received this rebate before
2. Qualify by income (e.g., household of 4 at $66,000 or less) or by enrollment in CARE, FERA, CalFresh, WIC, SSI, LIHEAP, Section 8, Clipper START, or similar programs
3. Buy an eligible used EV at a participating dealership
4. The dealer applies the rebate and submits paperwork for you
5. Keep proof of income in case you are selected for an audit
keywords: electric vehicle, EV, used car, rebate, WestLight Energy, Peninsula Clean Energy, PCE, San Mateo, Los Banos, plug-in hybrid, clean transportation
